title: Go-to-Prod Smoke & Surge Readiness Planner
content:
Purpose:
This is a working planner for the next feature launch (staged rollout to Hosted + Dedicated tiers). Focus areas: smoke validation, KPI burn/surge planning, ops contacts, and go/no-go criteria for each phase. This doc is purposely lightweight — use it as the single source of truth for pre-prod checks and runbook stubs for the first 72 hours post-traffic shift.

Scope and assumptions:
- Scope: Hosted API + Dedicated; exclude Private on-prem for this rollout.
- Traffic model: initial 1% of total prod traffic (pilot), then 10% beta ramp, then 100% ramp over 7 days.
- Safety: automated fallback to previous model variant and regional traffic cutover available.
- SLA targets must be met for Hosted customers; Dedicated customers get a reduced latency SLA but higher throughput guarantees.

Key success metrics (current baseline -> target):
- 95th pct latency (inference): 210ms -> target <= 250ms under pilot; <= 300ms under 10% ramp.
- Error rate (5xx): 0.6% -> target <= 1.0% during ramp; action threshold 0.5% sustained for 10m.
- Token cost delta vs baseline: +0% -> target <= +15% unit-cost increase.
- Customer-facing regressions (quality eval set): BLEU-like score delta <= -1.5 points on holdout tests.
- Uptime (service): 99.95% -> target >= 99.9% during rollout window.

Readiness checklist (pre-pilot; owners in parens):
- Config done: rollout policy + canary window set in Console (Maya T.).
- Capacity: Dedicated pool reservation and spillover policy validated (Carlos R.).
- Infra smoke: end-to-end smoke runbook created and rehearsed (Owen B.).
- Monitoring: dashboards with token-level cost, p50/p95/p99, 5xx, retry rates, and kv-cache hit rates are live (Priya D.).
- Alerts: PagerDuty playbooks and severity matrix updated; escalation chain verified (Zoe M.).
- QA: canary eval set of 120 prompts + expected outputs and automated scoring in CI (QA lead).
- Security: KMS key-policy verified for Dedicated artifacts (Security eng).
- Customer comms: support KB draft + status page pre-seeded (Support).
- Rollback plan: documented automatic model switch, manual traffic cutover procedures in ops runbook (Maya T. / SRE).

Pilot (1%) day-of checklist:
- T-60m: Final signoff call with product-ops, infra, SRE, on-call PM (owners listed).
- T-10m: Begin reduced TTL for routing (to allow rollback within 5m).
- T+0: Shift 1% traffic. Confirm low-volume smoke tests fire and pass.
- T+5m: Stability check 5m window: p95 < target and error rate < action threshold.
- T+30m: Evaluate QA scoring; if quality delta > threshold, initiate rollback.
- T+60m: Decision point: continue to 10% or hold/rollback. Decision recorded in release log (Maya T.).

10% Beta ramp checklist (if pilot ok):
- Autoscaler validation at 2.5x requests per second.
- KV cache effectiveness: success if cache hit >= 65% on prefix-heavy traffic.
- Cost alarms: alert if projected token cost > 12% delta vs forecast.
- Fallback variants: ensure fallback to quantized model viable with degraded latency but better throughput.

Surge & capacity plan (ops cheat numbers):
- Expected RPS per 1000 users: 2.1 rps.
- Pilot pool: reserve 0.5 gpus per 10k requests/minute (rough guide for Dedicated).
- Beta pool: scale to 2 gpus per 10k requests/minute; enable burst autoscaling policy capped to 4x baseline.
- Hot standby region: pre-warmed nodes equal to 10% of beta pool.

KPI burnup sketch (quick view):
- Day 0 (pilot): users 1k, processed requests 130k, p95 190ms, 5xx 0.3%
- Day 2 (beta 10%): users 10k, processed requests 1.2M, p95 230ms, 5xx 0.8%
- Day 7 (full): users 100k, processed requests 12M, p95 280ms, 5xx 0.9%
(These are projections to be fed into finance/cost-tracking sheet.)

Critical runbook snippets (paste into Console runbook):
- Emergency rollback: 
  1) Toggle model traffic to last-known-good variant in Console.
  2) If region-wide issues, cut traffic to alternate region and open incident bridge.
  3) Notify sales + key customers in the affected cohort.
- Resource exhaustion: 
  1) Increase autoscaler upper-bound by +50% for 10 minutes.
  2) If memory OOMs or host failures, reduce batch size config in runtime via feature flag and shift traffic.

Communication & stakeholder plan:
- T-60: Slack channel #prodops-launch pre-warmed; join link in Confluence page.
- T-0: Status pings every 15m first 2 hours, then 30m until 24h.
- Post-mortem: 72h triage doc to be created (owner: Maya T.).

Open questions / to decide:
- Quality rollout threshold: do we require absolute or relative quality pass? (action: Priya to propose by EOD).
- Cost ceiling for Hosted tier during beta: finance approval needed for +15% cap (action: Carlos to follow with finance).
- Customer opt-in: will any enterprise customers be held on the auto-rollout? (sales to confirm list).

Quick links (operational):
- Smoke test runbook: Confluence /prodops/smoke-tests (internal link).
- Incident bridge template: Confluence /sre/incident-bridge-template.
- Dashboard: Console -> Launch > Maya T. Launch dashboard (shared).
- Tickets: JIRA PRODOPS-4123 (rollout orchestration), INFRA-982 (autoscaling edge fixes).

Notes to reviewers:
- This is a working doc — prefer edits inline. If you change a checkpoint, update the decision table at the bottom with rationale.
- After signoff, I will copy critical runbook snippets into the Console runbook and tag on-call rosters.

Decision table (recorded outcomes during rollout):
- pilot_decision: (placeholder)
- beta_decision: (placeholder)
- full_rollout_decision: (placeholder)

Revision history:
- 2024-11-15 created by Maya T.
- 2024-12-05 added surge numbers and capacity heuristics (Carlos R.).
- 2025-01-20 ops runbook snippets refined and added decision table (Maya T.).

End of planner.
